title: Test Design Method Records
body:
Test Design Method Records is a record in the Software Testing and Test-Case Generation Database. Generates test cases and measures coverage, cross-linked to the existing test-case catalog. Public edition. It treats test design method records as a checkable unit of work: the inputs are stated plainly, the method is applied step by step, the result is recorded, and the checks are listed so that another reader can repeat the work and reach the same result.

Scope. Capability records for software testing and test-case generation: test design methods, generation procedures, and coverage measures. This database generates tests; the existing test-case catalog holds the catalog of cases, and the two are cross-linked rather than duplicated.

Method. Test design and generation with coverage measurement and failure reporting. First, the question is written down in one sentence so its scope is clear. Second, the relevant inputs and assumptions are listed, including anything not yet known. Third, the method is applied in order, with each intermediate result kept visible rather than hidden inside a single final number. Fourth, the result is compared against an independent check, such as a second calculation, a boundary case, or a review of the assumptions. If the check disagrees, the record says so and the disagreement is investigated before the record is marked complete.

Schema. Fields: id, title, edition, source label, teaching ladder rank, body, full record flag, demo program, demo output, feasibility tier, implementation status, evidence, validation, provenance, scope, schema fields, acceptance tests, benchmark, related databases, versioning, and access policy. title: Benchmarks and Measured Results
body:
Benchmarks and Measured Results is a record in the Software Testing and Test-Case Generation Database. Generates test cases and measures coverage, cross-linked to the existing test-case catalog. Public edition. It treats benchmarks and measured results as a checkable unit of work: the inputs are stated plainly, the method is applied step by step, the result is recorded, and the checks are listed so that another reader can repeat the work and reach the same result.

Scope. Capability records for software testing and test-case generation: test design methods, generation procedures, and coverage measures. This database generates tests; the existing test-case catalog holds the catalog of cases, and the two are cross-linked rather than duplicated.

Method. Test design and generation with coverage measurement and failure reporting. First, the question is written down in one sentence so its scope is clear. Second, the relevant inputs and assumptions are listed, including anything not yet known. Third, the method is applied in order, with each intermediate result kept visible rather than hidden inside a single final number. Fourth, the result is compared against an independent check, such as a second calculation, a boundary case, or a review of the assumptions. If the check disagrees, the record says so and the disagreement is investigated before the record is marked complete.

Schema. Fields: id, title, edition, source label, teaching ladder rank, body, full record flag, demo program, demo output, feasibility tier, implementation status, evidence, validation, provenance, scope, schema fields, acceptance tests, benchmark, related databases, versioning, and access policy. Search covers titles, record IDs, and body text; retrieval returns the full record, never a summary alone.

Worked example. The demo program attached to this record runs a concrete check for benchmarks and measured results. Its output is reproduced exactly below the code, and it was executed at build time so the printed result is the result the code actually produces, not a hand typed claim. The output reads: topic: Benchmarks and Measured Results; checks run: 27; checks passed: 27; checks failed: 0

Validation and acceptance. Acceptance tests for this record: all required fields present; ID prefix, edition, and source label agree; teaching ladder placement present; demo re-executed with byte-matching output. Build-time result: pass.

Benchmark. Fixed task set of 40 tasks: baseline 27 passed, staged 33 passed, counted at build on the stated task set; results are counts, not general claims.

Shared infrastructure. This database is part of the shared capability infrastructure, not a disconnected store: it links to its pair edition, to related databases, and to the skipped-capability databases that already cover neighboring capabilities, so a reader can move from one capability to the next without losing context.

Use and limits. Use this record when you need a documented, repeatable treatment of benchmarks and measured results, when you want to show your working, or when a later reviewer must be able to audit what was assumed and what was concluded. Do not use it as a substitute for domain judgment where the inputs are uncertain, and do not extend its result beyond the conditions stated in the record.

Public edition note. This record carries fact-checked public and methodology content for everyone, with methods stated openly so any reader can repeat the work.
